name: Activity Monitor
author: Brett
description: A live, plain-English log of everything the console, axHub and every app does: taps and console actions, plugin commands, axHub runs and approvals, agent and crew requests, orchestrator decisions (queued, split, launched, rejected, handed off), headless sessions, errors and the fixes after them (linked to the Automatic fixes notes). Each line says who did what, to whom and what came of it; one request and everything after it fold into a tree. Coloured by kind and severity, tabs (All, Errors, Approvals, Agents, Builds, axHub, one per app), live follow, search, filters, time range, pause and export. Select any event to retry it, open what it touched, jump to its fix note or make a rule: when this happens again, notify, run the fix, send it to an agent or run a console action. A widget with the live count and the last error sits in the activity banner and the Builds toolbar. Full REST / MCP / CLI control (plugin-commands@1) and the axf.activity-log@1 service.

items.title: Read and search the activity log
items.description: Every event as a plain-English sentence, newest last. Filters: tab (all, errors, approvals, agents, builds, axhub, app:<name>), q (words), kind, severity, minSeverity, app, source, actor, range (15m, 1h, 1d, 1w), since / until (epoch ms), chain, limit, view=tree for request chains.
